observations.subject: Third city travel row clipped at 1920x1080
observations.detail: The campaign panel is readable, but its lower edge masks the third city row. Indices 0-2 show only the Seven Hills name; progress and travel/status button are below the visible area. In index 4 the progress is visible but the travel button text and lower button edge are cut off. These images do not demonstrate a fully visible three-city panel. Runtime scrolling/reachability cannot be established from these still images.

observations.subject: Government request capture shows the wrong speaker and text
observations.detail: 03_rockos_third_city_government_request.png visibly displays Mila · Anbau with a generic getting-to-know-you dialogue and Mila portrait. It does not show Rocko or the Seven Hills government request advertised by its filename. The government request is legible in the campaign panel in indices 0-2 and 4.

observations.subject: Reward modal covers the claimed city memories
observations.detail: Both memory_in_city images still show the reward celebration modal. The permanent-memory reward names are legible and appropriate, but the world character and actual saved memory presentation remain covered by the modal.

observations.subject: Initial hill abandonment is visually weak
observations.detail: The before-growth Quellhuegel already has clean stone terraces, intact railing, healthy flowers, and a bench. Its small wood/debris pile is visible, but does not make the dominant landmark look abandoned. Later restored views are outside this reviewer group and must be compared by their assigned reviewer.

observations.subject: Arrival and first garden progression are coherent
observations.detail: Seven Hills HUD has readable counters and unobstructed navigation. The focus view centers the town hall, Rocko is correctly depicted in the actual arrival dialogue, the next tutorial objective is clear, and the construction fence communicates the running first build. The inspector has a clipped lower scroll-content line above its fixed action buttons; its key construction status and actions remain readable.

observations.subject: Four world districts are visually readable
observations.detail: Farm, town center, residential quarter, and workshop area retain distinct buildings and paths. Seven Hills signs and terrace landmarks are visible. Fixed HUD and dock stay within the image bounds, and the palette is coherent. These views use an explicitly grown fixture, as indicated by their very large local population.

observations.subject: Mila personal chapters and decision are legible
observations.detail: Mila Morgen name, teacher/books role, chapter titles, fresh-goal counters, reward and biography text are readable. Both third-chapter decision buttons are fully visible; the selected common meeting-place decision is shown in the accepted state. No missing-glyph or button-caption clipping was observed in these German story views.
